messages.subject: [FLR-list] problem with FLSAM
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
  I'm trying to use FLSAM but it doesn't work :( It stops immediately 
after the first row (ANCHOVY.sam <- 
FLSAM(ANCHOVY,ANCHOVY.tun,ANCHOVY.ctrl)) and this error appears:

Using model.init
Error trying to open data input file c:\users\s5fa3~1.dat
DATASECTION
sam.dat... Error trying to read in model data
  This is usual caused by a missing DAT file
Error in FLSAM(ANCHOVY, ANCHOVY.tun, ANCHOVY.ctrl) : An error occurred 
while running ADMB. Return code 1. In addition: Warning message: running 
command './sam.exe -nr 2 -noinit -iprint 5' had status 1

Also, my collegue can run the assessment using the same data and the 
same r version. Probably there is somenthing wrong on my pc, but I can't 
understand what is wrong...  Someone can help me to solve this problem?
Thank you so much.
  Silvia


-- 
Dr. Silvia Angelini, Ph.D.

messages.subject: [FLR-list] problem with FLSAM
messages.body_plain:
Dear Silvia,

I tried to run your assessment with the data that you forwarded. 

As with your colleague, the assessment does start to converge (it doesn't succeed, it throws an error, but at a far later stage than where it stops for you).

As Iago pointed out, could you indicate the version of R you are using and what version of FLSAM?

I'm running FLSAM 1.02 on R3.0.2.

Cheers, Niels
